verdict.rationale: Dagster docs confirm cron-based and interval schedules (dagster-docs-4, dagster-docs-31), sensors for event-driven/manual-like triggering (dagster-docs-5), Declarative Automation for condition-based scheduling (dagster-docs-6), and manual runs via UI/CLI are implied throughout. This covers sub-hour cron schedules, sensors, and manual triggers per asset/job. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on corroboration of per-pipeline frequency control in production, and no explicit example of sub-hour cron configuration in the evidence pack.
